programme.title: Newscast
programme.desc: Join BBC journalists including political editor Laura Kuenssberg, Europe editor Katya Adler, Brussels correspondent Adam Fleming and political correspondent Chris Mason in their weekly podcast discussing all of the news stories that matter to the people of the United Kingdom. The journalists know all about the stories that they're talking about - they interview the most important people involved in the stories that feature in the news. They speak of their knowledge and understanding of the news in a way that is understandable for all. Laura is often in a car in the middle of a city where big politics stories are happening. Katya, Adam and Chris are usually in the studio. They regularly talk about Brexit and what is going to happen when the United Kingdom leaves the European Union.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. The BBC is aims to be a totally impartial public service broadcaster, and was established by Royal Charter. The BBC is funded by a licence fee paid by British households, and is regulated by Ofcom. They aim to create high-quality content, in order to inform and educate, but also entertain, their audience Millions of people from all over the world watch content produced by the BBC, and they are well respected as a media company. It was founded in 1922, with its headquarters in Westminster, London.

programme.title: Newsday
programme.desc: "Good Morning Asia, hello World." Join the news teams from BBC World News in London and Singapore. This live news and current affairs program is broadcast globally and focuses on all the latest news and breaking developing stories that matter around the world. The show is usually presented by Rico Hizon in Singapore and Kasia Madera in London. Broadcasting live at midnight GMT on both BBC World News and the BBC News channel, the show is broadcast in the morning in Asia and therefore is marketed as a morning show for people watching around the country. The show is often followed by Asia Business Report live from Singapore which reports on all the latest economy and business figures from the country.

programme.desc: Focus on Africa is a BBC news program broadcast globally and on local partner channels of the BBC in African countries. The program used to be presented by Komla Dumor each weekday from its inception until his death in 2014; now it is hosted by Sophie Ikenye, a news presenter from Kenya. The program includes news, sport and business from across Africa and the rest of the globe. Get the top African stories and keep up with the latest international events.

programme.title: BBC World News America
programme.desc: News presenter Katty Kay keeps you up to date with all the latest breaking news from America and the rest of the world on BBC World News America. This world renowned news and current affairs program has been recognised for its exceptional reporting at the Emmy Awards. BBC World News America won two Emmy awards for its coverage of the conflicts in Syria and the Central African Republic. You can catch up with this award winning broadcast team as they air multiple times a day throughout the week.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: In-depth news and current affairs review of the main political and economic stories of the day, featuring robust interviews with senior government and opposition figures, business and union leaders, and analytical reports that delve behind the headlines. Regular presenters cross-examine studio guests on details of policies, priorities, actions and inactions, on a range of domestic UK and international topics. There are weekly features on the arts, sports and the world of technology, and editors are not afraid to venture into niche, specialist and exotic areas from space travel to animal psychology. If the BBC's flagship Radio 4 Today programme sets the early morning news agenda for the day, then its late-night TV equivalent often gives the people in power some sleepless nights.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Miami
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Miami is a documentary reality series following dedicated animal control officers as they provide a valuable service to the animals of Miami-Dade County. Keeping a close eye on the region's creatures, both wild and domesticated, the control officers visit various locations to investigate reports of injured or sick animals, and deplorable cases of animal cruelty, ensuring they are provided with the welfare they deserve. The series also follows individuals from the Everglades Outpost nature rehabilitation centre, as they investigate reports of animals being improperly released into the wetland area.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Houston
programme.desc: Animal Cops - Houston is the third Animal Planet series to follow the work of animal cruelty investigators. This particular series follows the animal cruelty investigators of the Houston Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (HSPCA). This team of 8 investigators works in a large area of Texas investigating reports of animal cruelty and, when necessary, removing animals from horrible abuse situations. Since these investigators do not have arrest or warrant seeking powers on their own, they work closely with local law enforcement, including the Harris County Precinct One Constable's Office. This office has permantly assigned Deputy Constable Christine Kendrick to assist the HSPCA investigators with any law enforcement issue that arises, including seeking warrents and arresting those charged with animal cruelty.

programme.title: The Vet Life

These guys became friends back in University, then they worked in Las Vegas and finally moved to Texas and opened a full-service veterinary hospital of their own. The series highlights their daily routine, their duties at work and at home, their families and pets.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.desc: Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.desc: Enjoy all the action and drama from the these competition bouts between the latest crop of top kickboxing fighters as they go toe-to-toe in this adrenalin-packed showcase. programme.title: Dream Boxing. Sarah Bormann - Perla Perez
programme.desc: DREAM BOXING stands as one of the most successful boxing promotions companies in the Europe for one reason: We take care of our fighters and our fans. Our fighters hail from around the world, attract a global audience, and span the ranks, from up-and-coming prospects to title contenders to world champions. We discover new talents, having a huge experience in amateurs ring, world and europe champions.

programme.title: MMA: Professional Fighters League
programme.desc: Watch the latest round of the Professional Fighters League, an MMA league where fighters compete in a regular season.

programme.title: American Chopper
programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: Shed And Buried: Classic Cars
programme.desc: Shed & Buried: Classic Cars sees Henry team-up with Fuzz Townshend once again. The duo will be doing what they do best: digging in the nation's sheds, barns and outbuildings, this time to (hopefully) find a tidy profit in some vintage motors.

programme.title: Mike Brewer: Born Dealer
programme.desc: Mike Brewer and his wife, Michelle, take on a new adventure closer to home, sharing a sneak peek into their lives at their new dealership in Warwick.

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Reality series focuses on the amazing opportunity to dive into American street racing world. Look at how need for speed unites people and find out what adrenaline addicts are ready for in Oklahoma, unofficial capital of illegal street racing. Only top racers participate in the competition, they want to appear and stay at the A-list, everything they have to do is to try to squeeze as much performance out of their vehicles as possible.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: As the modern world becomes progressively automated and mechanised it's easy to become detached from how things are made and how they work. The hit series returns to uncover the miraculous feats of engineering which underpin life in the 21st century. How the seemingly mundane are often the result of highly sophisticated engineering and production processes. This fascinating behind-the-scenes journey delves deep into the production of everyday modern items from surfboards to satchels and trombones to cricket bats.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock.

programme.title: Filthy Fortunes
programme.desc: The show follows extreme-cleaning specialist Matt Paxton, dubbed the "King of Hoards," as he wades into America's most cluttered homes in search of hidden treasures. Think "American Pickers" meets "Hoarders," with a dash of financial gamble thrown in for good measure.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Garage Rehab
programme.desc: American petrol head and reality TV star, Richard Rawlings, famous for his show Fast N' Loud, visits struggling garages and car workshops that are desperate for a helping hand. Alongside the team of world-class mechanics from his Gas Monkey Garage, Richard invests his precious time and money to get these toiling businesses back where they belong. The team visit workshops all over the USA, using their knowledge and experience to rev up the old girls and get their engines purring once more. With a serious amount of elbow grease on top of the help from Richard's team, the owners have a shot once more at a successful business.

programme.desc: For years the Raney family has helped novice homesteaders around the country save their homesteads from brink of failure and helped to bring their dreams of living off the grid to life. Now, inspired by years' worth of rescues, Marty Raney will attempt his greatest rescue of all – his very own 40-acre homestead. In an all new series, HOMESTEAD RESCUE: RANEY RANCH, the Raneys take on the most ambitious project the family has ever attempted, to build a multi-generational homestead.

programme.title: American Chopper: Senior vs Junior
programme.desc: "American Chopper" is back ... sort of. After that popular motorcycle-building reality series crashed after six seasons amidst a Teutul family feud, Paul Sr. and son Paul Jr. return as competitors. Senior and his staff continue their work at Orange County Choppers, while Junior launches Paul Jr. Designs across the street from OCC's original site. Not only that, but Paulie twists the knife even more by hiring former OCC employees, including his brother Mikey, Vinnie DiMartino, Robert "Nub" Colard and Joe Puliafico. With the battle lines drawn, who will survive by designing and building the most innovative choppers?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

programme.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
programme.desc: American reality series is about Alaskan pioneers Yule and Ruth Kilcher and their kids living together at their homestead. The Kilchers demonstrate one-of-a-kind model of surviving in severe conditions of the last frontier. Enjoy amazing panorama views of Alaska, showing its various nature. Sitting in a comfortable chair in your warm apartment just try to imagine how it really is when electricity and running water is not inevitable fact of life. The Kilchers hunt, go fishing, garden, gather, raise livestock in order to survive Alaska's uncontrollable power and wilderness.

Most episodes finished by examining some sort of disaster scenario which could threaten or ruin the project that was being examined.

programme.title: Polyfamily
programme.desc: Taya struggles to rekindle the romance on a date night with Tyler. Plus, Alysia becomes jealous when boundaries are crossed.

programme.title: Outdaughtered
programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: The Blended Bunch
programme.desc: What started with tragedy, manifested into a once in a lifetime love story. Before meeting, Erica, a mother of 7, lost her husband to cancer and Spencer, a father of 4, lost his wife in a fatal car crash. Their worlds were completely shattered until they serendipitously met in an online widower support group. Finding love almost immediately, Erica and Spencer exchanged vows and were married after just 13 months. The series centers on their large, newly blended family that will face all kinds of challenges as they merge 11 children under one roof and adjust to a new life in Utah.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?
programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Drawing the attention of the entire world, three fatal design flaws put air crash investigators in a storm of controversy. When one of former race car driver Niki Lauda's planes nosedives into a Thai jungle, a one-in-a-million failure reveals a weak spot in every Boeing 767. A piece of the plane blows off a Turkish Airlines DC-10 causing the most catastrophic mid-air emergency of its time. And, a risky test flight is the only way to uncover the startling truth about what brought down Atlantic Southeast Airlines Flight 2311.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Three planes fatally out of balance force investigators to question every calculation. It's a flight risk that's entirely preventable, and yet repeated disasters reconfirm the need for critical backup systems. With nearly 90,000 pounds of denim on board, a cargo plane in Miami crashes moments after lifting off. A packed commuter flight slams into a North Carolina hangar, revealing a deadly industry oversight. And, the NTSB is called in when a jumbo jet loaded with armored military vehicles pancakes to the ground in Afghanistan.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: Tuesday, September 11, 2001, a temperate and nearly cloudless morning over the eastern United States. Millions of men and women ready themselves for work. Among them is an air traffic controller in Boston, Mass. Based on sheer intuition, he will break all protocol this morning, alerting the Air Force that a potential disaster is unfolding on his radar screen. Air Force Colonel Bob Marr, commander NEADS (North East Air Defense Sector] will scramble all he has to try and avert a catastrophe - but it will consist of only two F-15's that begin "searching for a needle in a haystack". Meanwhile, a group of 19 young men armed with simple box cutters literally fly under the radar into the World Trade Center , The Pentagon, and a Pennsylvania field. From the viewpoint of these two key theaters of action, Air Traffic Control and the U.S. Air Force, "Seconds From Disaster: 9/11" deconstructs, second-by-second, the tragic events and security lapses that led to the worst attacks on American soil since Pearl Harbor. The episode contains chilling testimony from the Air Force Colonel Bob Marr , Air Traffic Controller Dave Bottiglia, Ben Sliney, the man who makes the call to ground all the planes in the air over the U.S. and John Farmer Senior Counsel for the Presidential Commission. The question has to be asked: even on the day, could 9/11 been stopped?

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: On a quiet Sunday morning in 1941 the pride of the US Navy rode calmly at anchor in the island paradise of Hawaii, far away from the war raging in Europe. That calm was abruptly shattered by the arrival of Imperial Japan's carrier taskforce that, in an unprecedented surprise attack, killed thousands and destroyed the American battleships that stood between Japan and its desire for a Pacific empire. This "day of infamy" seemed to be the most successful pre-emptive strike in history and a disaster for the United States. But was it? Seconds from Disaster takes a fresh look at one of history's greatest events and investigates whether the attack was in fact a fatal blow to Japan's quest for victory.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In 16th-century France, astrologer Nostradamus wrote hundreds of cryptic verses implying impossible knowledge of future events, including the French Revolution, the Second World War, the assassination of JFK, and the attacks of Sept. 11, 2001. Who was Nostradamus, and what did he say? In Central Europe, local legends say Houska Castle guards a portal to hell and is the site of dark, storied history. Here, young poet Karel Hynek Macha had a feverish dream of a future that terrified him. In medieval Italy, St. Francis of Assisi was subjected to the world's first case of stigmata, receiving the wounds of the Christian messiah on his hands, feet and torso. Are the stigmata a blessing, a curse, or a traditional blend of legend and truth? Final

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In early-1900s Russia, Grigori Rasputin, the professed mystical healer, was both admired and disdained. Some believed he had the czar and czarina under a dark spell. The true Rasputin is hard to decipher, but his claims of prophetic powers led to a controversial and tragic role pivotal to Russian history. In China, a scholar found strange markings on ancient bones that unlocked age-old mysteries. The ancient Chinese believed these "oracle bone" markings could contain traces of the future. In Point Pleasant, West Virginia, a mysterious winged creature is sighted moments before a tragic bridge collapse. The creature, dubbed the "Mothman," sparked decades of debate. Is it real, and did it portend impending doom?

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: The oldest and youngest carriers from Airport Security Colombia and Peru. A woman with cocaine and a record. 19-year-old student carries to help his sick mother. An old man from the Marshall Islands may be part of a trend to enlist the elderly as carriers. A young Venezuelan man risks it all due to conditions at home.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation

programme.title: LSD & the Psychedelic Revolution
programme.desc: For years drugs like LSD and psilocybin were forced into the shadows in a de facto prohibition against all things psychedelic. Today researchers, activists, and healers are bringing a new understanding of how psychedelics can help us negotiate everyday life. From cluster headaches to PTSD; from ancient Egypt to modern Detroit; National Geographic investigates LSD and the Psychedelic Revolution.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: It takes years of training to become an airline captain, but it's when a crisis strikes that a pilot really earns his stripes. An airliner is crippled after takeoff from New York's LaGuardia Airport, and the courageous captain pulls off an amphibious landing in the Hudson River. A catastrophic failure strikes high above the Canadian Prairies turning a Boeing 767 into a very large and very heavy glider. And, when the engines of TACA Flight 110 flame out in a violent storm, its captain pulls off one of the most remarkable landings in the history of commercial aviation.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Three mysterious accidents send investigators hunting for clues. In the end, all three trails lead back to the same source-the fuel tank. Minutes before touching down in Portland, United Airlines 173 loses all four engines over a densely populated suburb. In Japan, a Boeing 737 lands safely, but then catches fire with all 165 passengers and crew still on board. And, nearly 700 miles off course, the crew of Varig Flight 254 are forced to make a crash landing in the Amazon jungle.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Amid civil war in 14th century Mongol-controlled China, scholar and strategist Liu Bowen lends his talents to a dynasty on the rise. But his name is also remembered for a more mysterious talent: fortune-telling with what some say is frightening precision. A series of cryptic prophecies earns him the moniker of China's "Nostradamus." In Ancient Rome, Julius Caesar receives a warning that his life is in danger. The prophecy, uttered by an Etruscan soothsayer, is divined through the strange art of haruspicy. Caesar ignores the omen at his own peril. Amongst the hills of the Scottish Lowlands, the influential Erskine family becomes haunted by a mysterious prophecy, presaging and inflicting countless moments of tragedy and heartbreak.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Edgar Cayce, known as the "sleeping prophet," claims to use hypnotic states to heal the sick and see the future. Cayce is alleged to have predicted the Wall Street Crash of 1929, the Second World War, and the assassination of JFK. His aura stokes fear around his most frightening prediction of all — the end of the world. In Ancient Greece, the Oracle of Delphi is the premier prophesier of the ancient world. The words of this Pythia, channeled down from Apollo, go on to shape human history, foretelling the rise and fall of empires. And in 19th-century France, radical occult thinker Eliphas Lévi draws upon early mysticism to develop a spiritual doctrine. Branded as a devil worshiper by the public, the truth of his life's work is even stranger.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Peru's biggest airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest problem: cocaine smuggling. The clothes in a 19-year-old's bag are oddly damp - they're soaked in liquid cocaine. Police uncover a 16 kg load in a suitcase. Officers detain two Colombians headed to Mexico. They've travelled from the Amazon - and they may be carrying. In the mail facility, cocaine is found infused in a blanket and hidden in artisanal boxes.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Peru's biggest airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest problem: cocaine smuggling. Two passengers are carrying cocaine in their bodies. programme.title: Airport Security: Peru

Kartmatud saatejuhid Indrek Vaheoja ja Kristjan Rabi proovivad erinevaid ameteid, võtavad vastu külalisi ja jagavad ellujäämise saladusi neljal õhtul nädalas. programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Kiired ja vihased: Tokyo Drift
programme.desc: USA / Saksamaa / Jaapan 2006 märul Lavastaja:Justin Lin Osades:Lucas Black, Zachery Ty Bryan, Shad Moss Sean Boswell on tuulepeast kiirendusvõistluste korraldaja, kes pageb parajasti politsei eest. Et Sean pogrist pääseks, saadetakse ta elama oma morni ja võõraks jäänud sõjaväelasest isa juurde, kes resideerub Tokyos. Sõbrunenud ameeriklase Twinkiega, kes tutvustab talle keelatud driftingu-võistlusi, satub Sean taas kahtlaste sündmuste keerisesse. Esimestel võistlustel kohtub pahaaimamatu nooruk kohaliku tðempioni D.K-ga, kel on sidemeid Jaapani kuritegeliku Yakuzaga. programme.desc: Charles alustab Nepalis hirmuäratavat hävitusretke, samal ajal kui Nadine aitab Hermanil koguda politsei jaoks lõplikke tõendeid.

programme.title: Elu allpool nulli
programme.desc: Andy ja Denise sõltuvad koertest. Rakend vajab aga usaldusväärset juhtkoera ning viimased külmad päevad kuluvad noorte koerte treenimiseks ja uue juhtkoera valimiseks. Ricko märkab suurt karibukarja ja loodab pääseda piisavalt lähedale. Chip soovib tabada äsja ärganud karu, ent jälgi pole veel näha. Kas pikad üksi veedetud kuud tekitavad Sues üksildust?

programme.title: ERR.ee uudised
programme.desc: Eesti Rahvusringhäälingu uudised - Eesti ja kogu maailma kõige värskemad uudised.

programme.title: Mutihärra Mutik
programme.desc: Mudison disainib Mutilinna karnevali jaoks uue atraktsiooni, mis töötab magnetjõul.

programme.title: Rebased ja mägrad
programme.desc: Täna tahab Roosi vanaisale luuletuse kirjutada. Kõikjal on aga hirmus müra ja Roosi ei saa kuidagi keskenduda. Kas luuletus saab ikka valmis?

programme.title: Floor paneb reeglid paika
programme.desc: Floori pere murrab pead, kuidas hoida häid suhteid kiusliku naabriga. Keesil on radikaalne lahendus.

programme.title: Lepatriinu ja Musta Kassi imelised lood
programme.desc: Marinette kohtub suurmeister Su-Hani, Imeliste Laeka Taevase Valvuriga, kes tahab Marinette'ilt Laegast ära võtta. Öölasel õnnestub mälu kaotanud meister Fu akuma mõjule allutada. Kas Lepatriinu suudab Fu päästa ja tõestada, et tema on Imeliste Valvur?

programme.title: Luise ja Oliver
programme.desc: Luise ja Oliver on õde ning vend, kes elavad oma tavalist õe ja venna elu. Mängivad põnevaid mänge, õpivad uusi teadmisi ja tunnevad huvi, kuidas maailmas asjad käivad. Ja isegi kui mõni teema neid vaidlema paneb, leitakse sõbralikult koos lahendus igale küsimusele. Näitlejad Maarja Johanna Mägi ja Aaron Thor Härm, režissöör Kristo Veinberg, stsenarist Maarja Johanna Mägi, produtsent Kadi Katarina Priske.

programme.title: Claude
programme.desc: Claude ja söör Topsusokk nuputavad, kuidas pääseda lord Lossitorni peenele koosviibimisele, mis on mõeldud ainult valitutele.

programme.title: Tom Gatesi äge maailm
programme.desc: Tom tutvustab oma lemmiktegevusi, mis kõik on lõbusad. Meisterdab savitulnukaid ja paneb aluse tantsuhullusele.

programme.title: Põrsas Peppa
programme.desc: Peppa on armas ja alati rõõmsameelne põrsaplika, kes elab koos oma väikese venna George'i, Emme Põssa ja Issi Põssaga. Peppale meeldib mängida, end põnevalt riidesse panna, väljas käia ja mudalompides hüpata. Ta seiklused lõpevad alati õnnelikult ja suure naeruga.

programme.title: Hei, Kutsa!
programme.desc: Õppima ja ühiselt tegutsema innustav joonissari on mõeldud koolieelikutele ja selle peategelane on suur sõbralik Kutsa. Kutsa on Oravaklubi juht – see on selline isevärki koht, kus lapsed saavad koos igasuguseid vahvaid seiklusi ette võtta ja uusi asju avastada. Kutsa õpetab lastele üksmeelt, sihikindlust ja vaprust. Iga kord teenivad lapsed auhinnaks mõne uue märgi.

programme.title: Rebased ja mägrad
programme.desc: Piia usaldab Roosi hoolde mudeli, mille kavatseb isale sünnipäevaks kinkida. Mis saab aga siis, kui mudel katki läheb?

programme.title: Magus molekul
programme.desc: Seekord valmib meie toidulaboris maitsev magustoit pirnidest - Aigar ja Sissi panevad sinna sisse head ning paremat. Kim Britt ja Aigar teevad katset aga pirni peamise koostisosa veega. Kim saab teada, miks ta vahel väga särtsakas on! "Magus molekul" on lastele ning nende vanematele loodud hoogne saade, kus kohtuvad toit ja teadus. Igas saates valmistavad Sissi Nylia Benita ning Aigar Vaigu kodumaistest toorainetest midagi maitsvat ja Aigar teeb koos väikese abilisega ka toiduteaduskatset.

programme.title: Peetrikese unenägu
programme.desc: Ühel hommikul leiab Peetrike, et ta on maailmas täiesti üksi. Ta hakkab vallatust tegema ja satub pööraste tempude tõttu väga täbarasse olukorda. Viimaks selgub, et see kõik oli üksnes halb unenägu. Esimene eesti nukufilm. Režissöör Elbert Tuganov, operaator Aimée Beekman, kunstnik Rein Raamat, helilooja Boris Kõrver.

programme.title: Mõmmi ja aabits
programme.desc: Üheksandas saates õpib Mõmmi selgeks K-tähe. Karu-Mati, Karu-Kati, Jänku-Juta, Rebase-Rein ja hundikutsikad saavad tunnistused. Mõmmi läheb neid õnnitlema. Uugul ja Uudul on tunnistusel ainult kahepuru ja Rebase-Rein aitab neid hädas. Aga kuidas? Mõmmi saab seekord selgeks tähe, millega algab karu, Kati ja kala. K-täht on Mõmmi meelest igal pool!

programme.title: Tom ja Fluffy
programme.desc: Humoorikas joonisfilmisari, mis räägib kahe noore koera Tomi ja Fluffy ning nende sõprade seiklustest.

programme.title: Kalailm
programme.desc: Viljandi järves elab tõeliselt suuri ahvenaid, kuid neid pole sugugi lihtne tabada. Kas meid viib sihile see, kui kasutame plumpsulante ehk poppereid? Ja kas aasta lõpuks on tõesti lõhedele-forellidele loodud jõepaisudest üle-, ümber-üle ülepääsud, nagu seadus ette näeb?

programme.title: Tõde ja valed
programme.desc: Ühiskonnas pole kellelgi pääsu mõjutajatest. Mõni neist on drastiliselt muutnud ajaloo kulgu. Nad on arvamusliidrid, kes oskavad ära kasutada vastava ajastu tehnoloogilisi tippsaavutusi, et oma vaateid levitada, kõhklemata selle nimel ka valetada ja tõde väänata.

programme.title: Vaikimisi
programme.desc: Elaine'i süüdistatakse joobes juhtimises ja Val kahtlustab taas Finni. Kuid peale Finni tekitab peavalu ka Jenny lapse isa, kes otsustab oma õigusi nõuda.

programme.title: MEIE BINGO!
programme.desc: Igas seltskonnas on keegi alati osav ja keegi kultuurne, keegi talub pinget ning kellelgi on alati õnne! Kuid kes see on? Sellele saame vastused saates "MEIE BINGO!", kus igal kolmapäeval tuleb külla üks vahva ja värvikas lotomängijate seltskond! Samal ajal saavad ennast proovile panna ka vaatajad kodudes ja selguvad ka Bingo loto võidunumbrid! Saatejuhid Christopher Rajaveer ja Anne Mari Saks.

programme.title: Kiiluvees
programme.desc: "Kiiluvees" viib meid tagasi aastasse 1943, mil paljud noored Eesti mehed seisid silmitsi raske valikuga - kas liituda Saksa sõjaväega või Punaarmeega. Ligi kolm tuhat noort meest otsustasid valida kolmanda tee ja sõita üle Soome lahe, saades tuntuks kui - soomepoisid. Aastal 1990 põimuvad saatused, kui Taimi, ingerisoome päritolu noor naine, armub Põhja-Soome mehesse ja otsustab elada Kuhmos. Ühise kodu ehitamise käigus avastab Taimi vanast kuurist kasti, milles on eestikeelsed veterinaaria käsiraamatud koos soomepoisi Heimo Soosalu kirjadega. See avastus paneb Taimi sügavalt mõtlema ja ta asub koos kohalike abiga jälgi ajama. Selgub, et Heimo on küll lugupeetud tohter, kuid teda seob saladuslik "rindepõgeniku" staatus. Taimi leiab Heimo lugudest inspiratsiooni ja otsustab koos vennaga austust avaldada nendele meestele, kes võitlesid Soome eest. Nende otsus sõuda üle Soome lahe muutub suureks ettevõtmiseks, millele soovitakse leida sponsoreid ja tähelepanu. See film räägib soomepoiste saatuslikust valikust, vaikimisest ja vaprusest ning üksikute inimeste pingutustest säilitada mälestusi ja austust nende meeste tegudele. Taimi võtab endale rolli produtsendina, et talletada nende väärtuslikku ajalugu ja jagada seda noorematele põlvedele. "Kiiluvees" on lugu jagatud saatusest, tugevusest ja järjepidevusest, ning see on pühendatud kõigile neile, kes andsid oma panuse Soome vabaduse nimel.
